mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'USERID_NOT_EXIST' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_ID_ENCPSWD = #{userIdEncpswd} ) THEN 'CORRECT_PSWD' ELSE 'WRONG_PSWD' END AS LOGIN_RESULT FROM DUAL

/* 설 명 : 사용자조회, ASIS - UsrUserInfoDAO.viewUser */ SELECT U.*, A.AUTHRT_CD , A.AUTHRT_GRPCD, O.ORG_ID, O.ORGNM FROM TB_LMS_USER U JOIN TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA ON U.USER_ID = UA.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT A ON UA.AUTHRT_ID = A.AUTHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON UA.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.USER_ID = #{userId}
/* 더미 쿼리로 userRprsId를 전달하는 역할만 수행 */ SELECT #{userRprsId} AS userRprsId FROM DUAL
/* 설 명 : 교수로등록된사용자아이디들조회*/ SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_RPRS_ID = #{userRprsId} AND USER_TYCD = 'PROF'
/* 설 명 : 학생으로등록된사용자아이디들조회*/ SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_RPRS_ID = #{userRprsId} AND USER_TYCD = 'STDNT'
/* SQL ID : UserDAO.userTycdList 설 명 : 시스템 관리자 구분 목록 조회 */ SELECT CD AS USER_TYCD , CDNM AS USER_TYCDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'USER_TYCD' AND CD != 'USER_TYCD' ORDER BY CD_SEQNO
